visualCharacteristics: Two side-by-side flat white panel boxes on a light-grey section, each a bold heading over a stacked list of plain blue text links (no chevrons, no dividers).
contentPattern: One row, one cell per column; additional rows must keep the same cell count. Each cell: heading followed by links (one per paragraph or list item).

structure.note: One row, one cell per column; additional rows must keep the same cell count.

usage.description: Side-by-side white panels, each with a heading and a stacked list of resource links.

reuseGuidance: Use for resource link directories shown as boxed panels. Put each link in its own paragraph or list item. Use columns-link-lists for divider-separated columns with chevron links.
